defaults.source: Distilled from [ui.shadcn.com](https://ui.shadcn.com) and the [shadcn-ui repository](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui), retrieved 2026-08-20. Components are React source you copy into your project, styled with Tailwind and built on Radix UI or Base UI.

setup.title: shadcn/ui setup
setup.description: shadcn/ui installation and configuration: CLI, components.json, Tailwind v4, Next.js, Vite, Remix, monorepo, React 19, MCP. Use when the request names shadcn setup, init or components.json.
setup.intro: Getting shadcn/ui into a project. The CLI copies component source into your repository — there is no runtime package, so an upgrade means re-running `add`.

theming.title: shadcn/ui theming
theming.description: shadcn/ui theming: CSS variable tokens, colour palettes, light and dark mode, Tailwind v4 @theme, RTL and direction. Use when the request names shadcn theming, colors or dark mode.
theming.intro: Colour, radius and typography come from CSS variable tokens rather than component props. Change a token and every component follows.

forms.title: shadcn/ui form components
forms.description: shadcn/ui form components: Form, Field, Input, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Slider, Combobox, DatePicker, Calendar, Label. Use when building a form with shadcn/ui.
forms.intro: Everything a form is assembled from. Form wraps react-hook-form and Zod; the rest are the controls it validates.

layout.title: shadcn/ui layout components
layout.description: shadcn/ui layout components: Card, Sidebar, Sheet, Drawer, Tabs, Accordion, Collapsible, Resizable, ScrollArea, Skeleton. Use when structuring a page with shadcn/ui.
layout.intro: Components that arrange a page rather than collect input. Sidebar is the largest and ships its own provider, hook and keyboard shortcut.

navigation.title: shadcn/ui navigation components
navigation.description: shadcn/ui navigation components: NavigationMenu, Menubar, DropdownMenu, ContextMenu, Command, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Kbd. Use when building navigation or a command palette with shadcn/ui.
navigation.intro: Menus, command palettes and positional cues. Command is the base for a searchable palette; the menu components differ mainly in trigger.

feedback.title: shadcn/ui feedback components
feedback.description: shadcn/ui feedback components: Dialog, Alert, Popover, Tooltip, Toast, Sonner, Progress, Badge, Button. Use when showing state or confirming with shadcn/ui.
feedback.intro: Components that tell the user something or ask them to confirm. AlertDialog interrupts and demands an answer; Dialog does not.

data.title: shadcn/ui data display
data.description: shadcn/ui data display: Table, DataTable with TanStack Table, 70 Recharts chart examples, Carousel. Use when the request names a shadcn table, data table or chart.
data.intro: Table is markup; DataTable adds TanStack Table for sorting, filtering and pagination. Charts wrap Recharts behind a ChartContainer and a config object.

blocks.title: shadcn/ui blocks and registry
blocks.description: shadcn/ui blocks and custom registries: dashboard, login, signup and sidebar blocks, registry.json, registry-item.json, the registry API. Use when the request names a shadcn block or registry.
blocks.intro: Blocks are multi-component page sections you copy whole. A registry publishes your own components for the CLI to install, including from a private URL.
